name: MOLA Mission Experiment Gridded Data Records
scientific_limitations: Accuracy degrades above ~87° latitude due to polar orbit geometry. Vertical accuracy ~1 m, horizontal ~100 m.
description: Global topographic dataset derived from over 600 million laser altimetry measurements by MOLA aboard Mars Global Surveyor. Provides the primary global elevation reference for Mars.

name: HRSC Digital Terrain Models
geographic_footprint: Partial global coverage along orbit tracks
scientific_limitations: Coverage is not global; limited to regions imaged with sufficient stereo convergence angle. Quality varies by orbit.
description: High-resolution stereo-derived digital terrain models from the HRSC camera on ESA's Mars Express orbiter, providing regional topography at higher resolution than MOLA.

name: USGS Geologic Map of Mars (SIM 3292)
scientific_limitations: 1:20,000,000 scale; not suitable for local-scale geologic analysis. Unit boundaries generalized from multiple source maps.
description: The first global unified geologic map of Mars published by the USGS (Tanaka et al., 2014), defining major geologic units and stratigraphic relationships at 1:20,000,000 scale.

name: HiRISE Reduced Data Records
coverage: Targeted observations, ~3% of Mars surface at full resolution
scientific_limitations: Targeted coverage only; not a global dataset. Large file sizes (>1 GB per observation). Color coverage narrower than red-band.
description: The highest-resolution orbital imagery of Mars, captured by HiRISE aboard MRO, enabling detailed study of surface features at sub-meter scale.

name: CTX Experiment Data Records
coverage: Over 99% of Mars surface imaged at least once
scientific_limitations: Grayscale only (panchromatic 500-800 nm). Geometric distortions in raw images require map projection.
description: Grayscale context imagery from the CTX camera on MRO, providing near-global 6 m/px coverage of Mars used for geomorphological mapping and HiRISE targeting context.

name: CRISM Targeted Reduced Data Records
instrument: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM)
coverage: Targeted mineralogy observations at thousands of sites
scientific_limitations: Detector degradation over mission lifetime reduces spectral quality in later data. Atmospheric correction required for surface mineral identification.
description: Visible and infrared reflectance spectroscopy data from CRISM on MRO, used to identify and map minerals on the Martian surface including phyllosilicates, sulfates, and iron oxides.

name: THEMIS Infrared Global Mosaic
coverage: Global daytime and nighttime infrared mosaics
scientific_limitations: Thermal inertia derivations depend on atmospheric and surface models. Day/night coverage completeness varies by region.
description: Global thermal infrared imagery from THEMIS aboard Mars Odyssey, providing daytime and nighttime surface temperature maps used for thermal inertia studies and compositional mapping.

name: MSL Radiation Assessment Detector Data
coverage: Continuous surface radiation measurements since landing
scientific_limitations: Point measurements at a single location; not representative of global radiation environment. Shielding by rover structure affects some channels.
description: Surface-level radiation dose rate and particle flux measurements from RAD on the Curiosity rover, essential for assessing human exploration radiation hazards on Mars.

name: MSL Rover Environmental Monitoring Station Data
scientific_limitations: Wind speed sensor partially damaged during landing; wind measurements have higher uncertainty. Single-site measurements in Gale Crater.
description: Environmental monitoring data from REMS on the Curiosity rover, including air/ground temperature, pressure, humidity, UV radiation, and wind speed/direction in Gale Crater.

name: MSL Curiosity Surface Imagery
coverage: Surface imagery along Curiosity traverse in Gale Crater
scientific_limitations: Mastcam left eye (M-34) lower resolution than right eye (M-100). MAHLI focus distance affects resolution. Color calibrated but not radiometrically calibrated in all products.
description: Surface imagery from Curiosity's camera suite including Mastcam (science cameras), MAHLI (hand lens imager for close-up geology), and MARDI (descent imager), documenting Gale Crater geology.

name: Mars 2020 Perseverance Surface Imagery
coverage: Surface imagery along Perseverance traverse in Jezero Crater
scientific_limitations: Mastcam-Z zoom optics provide variable resolution. SuperCam RMI has narrower FOV than Mastcam-Z. Ongoing mission; dataset continuously growing.
description: Surface imagery from Perseverance's camera suite including Mastcam-Z (zoomable stereo cameras), SuperCam Remote Micro-Imager, and WATSON (close-up imager), documenting Jezero Crater delta and ancient lakebed geology.
